summary: Etherpad plugin exposes unauthenticated host-reconnaissance endpoint
details: The package registers an Etherpad plugin hook (expressPreSession in ep.json) that adds an undocumented unauthenticated GET route /Nx_75232/ to the installer's Etherpad HTTP server. The handler returns the host's hostname, OS username, platform, Node.js version, current working directory, and process id, wrapped in a 'Nxploited | Nx-zD' banner. Any remote client that can reach the Etherpad instance can retrieve this host-identity information without authentication, providing reconnaissance data for follow-on targeting of the server. The route is not described by the package name or any plugin documentation, and the attacker-branded response makes the recon purpose explicit.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
